art_prompt: Small centered chest illustration of a delicate satin bow tied around a small dumbbell, soft pastel watercolor-style linework with light shading, minimal and clean, colors blush pink, cream, sage green, muted mauve, text sitting in elegant script above the bow-and-dumbbell icon.
title: Soft Girl Heavy Lifts Oversized Tee, Cute Gym Cover Up Shirt, Pastel Workout Shirt Gift for Her, Boxy Lifting Tee
description:
Soft on the outside, heavy on the bar - this oversized tee is built for the girls who lift hard and still want to look cute walking out of the gym. A dainty bow-and-dumbbell icon keeps it sweet, never basic.

Cut boxy and roomy in muted sand cotton, it slides easily over a sports bra between sets or works as an everyday oversized tee with leggings and sneakers.

A feel-good gift for the lifter in your life who deserves something as strong and soft as she is.

Design created by our shop with the help of AI tools and printed on demand by our production partner.
risk_notes: Original wording and generic icon, no trademarked slang or brand references used.
